name: Flipnote Studio 3D™
description:
Draw, turn, draw, turn. "Moving Memo Pad 3D" is software that allows you to create moving memos in the same way as a flip book. Use 6 colored pens to draw, erase, and paint. You can also create memos that take advantage of stereoscopic vision using three layers. There are also a lot of useful tools for editing.

To use the paid community service "World Flipnote Gallery" that allows you to share your works with Flipnote users other than your friends, you must purchase a "30-day ticket (use ticket)" for 100 yen every 30 days, or a "1-day ticket (use ticket)" for 30 yen for each day.

*You can enjoy the service for free for 30 days from the first connection.
*You can enjoy it for free during free time (15:00 to 21:00 every day).
disclaimer:
Ticket sales at "World Flipnote Gallery" will end at 10:00 AM on October 2, 2017.
This service will end at 10:00 AM on April 2, 2018. Please check the Nintendo homepage for details.
As of November 1, 2013, the "Friend Flipnote Gallery" service has been discontinued. Thank you for your understanding.
